name: Penguin ePulse
description_en:
Penguin ePulse is a web-based social media workspace joining content preparation, connected-account conversations, reporting and source-linked market research. Its public surfaces are Create, Calendar, Inventory, ORM Center, Analytics & Reports, Market Listening/Data Intelligence and AI Studio. The official site identifies cleourban.com as the application for this same product and notes the earlier Penguine Pulse name. It is distinct from Pulse Penguin.

Its documented value proposition is keeping account, conversation and evidence context available across handoffs. A retail team could investigate recurring delivery questions, prepare an explanatory post and review subsequent activity. That is an editorial evaluation scenario, not a measured customer result. Actual supported channels, actions, permissions, research providers and commercial allowances still need confirmation. The public charts and saved Demo Brand views are explicitly examples; this research did not enter an account or execute publishing, replies or paid collection.
description_zh:
Penguin ePulse 是网页社交媒体工作区，结合内容准备、已连接账户会话、报告及附来源市场研究。公开界面包括 Create、Calendar、Inventory、ORM Center、Analytics & Reports、Market Listening／Data Intelligence、AI Studio。官网确认 cleourban.com 为同一产品应用，并注明原名 Penguine Pulse；它与 Pulse Penguin 不同。

其文档价值是让交接持续保留账户、会话及证据语境。零售团队可调查反复出现的配送问题、准备解释帖，再检查后续活动。这是编辑评估场景，并非实测客户成果。实际支持渠道、动作、权限、研究提供方及商业额度仍需确认。公开图表及已存 Demo Brand 视图明确为示例，本研究未进入账户或执行发布、回复、付费采集。

core_features.explanation_en: Create, Calendar and Inventory connect drafts, media and planning.
core_features.explanation_zh: Create、Calendar、Inventory 连接草稿、媒体及规划。

core_features.explanation_en: Review supported conversations with original thread context.
core_features.explanation_zh: 带原始线程语境审阅支持的会话。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose question/sources before reviewing linked findings.
core_features.explanation_zh: 先选问题／来源，再审阅附链接发现。

core_features.explanation_en: Assistant responses depend on available data, tools and confirmations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 助手回复取决于可得数据、工具及确认。

en: Coordinate a brand content plan with relevant customer conversations.
Prepare a source-linked research brief on a defined market question.
Review account reporting with explicit dates and metric definitions.
zh: 将品牌内容计划与相关客户会话协调。
就明确市场问题准备附来源研究简报。
按明确日期及指标定义审阅账户报告。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Confirm the Penguin ePulse/CleoUrban workspace identity and required account types.
steps.zh: 确认 Penguin ePulse／CleoUrban 工作区身份及所需账户类型。

steps.en: Bring a representative post, anonymized conversation and reporting question to a demo.
steps.zh: 向演示提供代表性帖子、匿名会话及报告问题。

steps.en: Verify formats, permissions, state transitions and provider results.
steps.zh: 核实格式、权限、状态转移及提供方结果。

steps.en: Review source scope and collection cost before running research.
steps.zh: 运行研究前审阅来源范围及采集费用。

steps.en: Agree commercial allowances, export needs and offboarding behavior.
steps.zh: 确定商业额度、导出需求及退出行为。

items.en: A connected account does not establish every publishing, reply or analytics action.
items.zh: 已连接账户不证明支持全部发布、回复、分析动作。

items.zh: 已存研究视图没有连接渠道且不执行发布。

items.en: Illustrative values are not customer outcomes or benchmarks.
items.zh: 示例数值不是客户效果或基准。

items.en: Disconnecting leaves previously saved and natively published material.
items.zh: 断开后此前保存及原生已发素材仍保留。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: No numerical plan price, seat/account allowance, permanent free tier, trial or billing interval was established from the official pages read. October 16, 2026 terms say a paid plan, price or usage allowance must be displayed or separately agreed before applying. Market Listening may incur research-provider costs depending on setup; no universal included collection budget was verified. Obtain the actual proposed plan and provider charges for the required channels and scope. No normalized price is assigned.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 所读官方页面未确定数字价格、席位／账户额度、永久免费档、试用或账单周期。2026 年 10 月 16 日条款说付费计划、价格、使用额度须先展示或另行约定。Market Listening 可能按配置产生研究提供方费用，未核普遍包含的采集预算。需取得所需渠道／范围的实际计划及提供方费用，不分配标准化价格。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Follow the actual account and content state through the calendar
sections.title_zh: 在日历中跟踪真实账户及内容状态
sections.en: Create prepares message/media, Inventory holds the content context and Calendar organizes the plan. The publishing page distinguishes draft, scheduled and completed states rather than treating a date as a completed send. Available actions depend on network, format, account type and permissions. Editorial launch example: bring one approved image/caption, identify its destination and timezone, then ask to see the state transition and provider result. The public page calls for a channel support matrix but does not supply a verified exhaustive one; automatic scheduling for every format is not established.
sections.zh: Create 准备文字／媒体，Inventory 保留内容语境，Calendar 组织计划。发布页区分草稿、计划、完成状态，不能把日期视为已发送。动作取决于网络、格式、账户类型及权限。编辑发布示例：带一份已审图片／说明，确认目的地及时区，再查看状态转移及提供方结果。公开页要求渠道支持矩阵，但未提供已核完整矩阵，不能确定所有格式都自动排程。

sections.title_en: An owned conversation is not all public reputation evidence
sections.title_zh: 自有账户会话不等于全部公开声誉证据
sections.en: ORM Center reviews supported comments and messages with their source account and original thread. Public comments and private messages require different routes, and a public comment cannot always receive a private reply. Broad public brand mentions belong to a separately scoped research question, not an assumed inbox capability. Editorial customer-service example: classify an anonymized delivery question as public or private, inspect permitted reply actions and identify who should review a sensitive response. The website’s example resolved-conversation totals are illustrative; they do not establish response speed, completeness or customer satisfaction.
sections.zh: ORM Center 携来源账户及原始线程审阅支持的评论与消息。公开评论、私信需要不同路径，公开评论并非总能私下回复。广泛公开品牌提及属于独立研究范围，不能假定收件箱具备。编辑客服示例：将匿名配送问题分为公开／私密，检查获准回复动作，并确定敏感回复审阅人。网站解决会话总数为示例，不能确定速度、完整性或满意度。

sections.title_en: Review collection scope before a paid research run
sections.title_zh: 付费研究运行前审阅采集范围
sections.en: Market Listening has Create a market brief and Analyze post URLs entry points. Its documented sequence is question, sources/dates, scope review and linked evidence. Saved evidence, research options, run results/history and a No publishing boundary appear in the described interface. The saved view has no connected channels, so it cannot demonstrate automatic owned-channel updates. Some collection uses paid providers. Editorial delayed-delivery research: define terms and a period, check provider readiness/cost and inspect original evidence before summarizing concerns. Public web results, search signals and owned conversations must retain their different scope; collection is not exhaustive social-network coverage.
sections.zh: Market Listening 有 Create a market brief、Analyze post URLs 两入口，文档顺序为问题、来源／日期、范围审阅、附链接证据。所述界面有已存证据、研究选项、运行结果／历史及 No publishing 边界。已存视图没有连接渠道，不能演示自有渠道自动更新。部分采集使用付费提供方。编辑延迟配送研究：定义词项、周期，检查提供方就绪／费用，总结前读原证据。公开网页、搜索信号、自有会话须保留不同范围，并非完整社交网络覆盖。

sections.title_en: Keep the denominator and reach aggregation explicit
sections.title_zh: 明确分母及触达汇总方式
sections.en: The analytics page’s saved Demo Brand view separates published posts, impressions, comments and engagements. Its illustrative 72 engagements divided by 4,933 impressions yields about 1.46%; that rate is not engagement by followers or reach. It also warns summed post reach is not a deduplicated audience across all posts. These example numbers do not benchmark a customer. Editorial monthly report: use one account, fixed dates and source-specific definitions, check missing intervals and confirm export/history availability. A social engagement total alone does not demonstrate leads, sales or causal return on investment.
sections.zh: 分析页已存 Demo Brand 视图区分已发布帖、展示、评论及互动。示例 72 互动除以 4,933 展示约为 1.46%，不是按关注者或触达计算。页面也警告逐帖触达相加不是所有帖去重受众。这些示例数不构成客户基准。编辑月报建议：统一账户、日期及来源定义，检查缺失区间并确认导出／历史可得性。社交互动总量本身不证明线索、销售或因果投资回报。

sections.title_en: Studio uses workspace context without adding data coverage
sections.title_zh: Studio 使用工作区语境，不增加数据覆盖
sections.en: AI Studio is an assistant surface, not a separate listening source. A request should identify workspace, account, task and date range; output depends on underlying data and supported tools. The feature page requires inspecting proposed actions and using available permissions/confirmations instead of assuming every instruction executes autonomously. Editorial example: ask for a draft explanation based on selected conversation evidence, inspect unsupported claims and then separately verify any offered outward action. The public documentation does not establish a universal approval hierarchy, autonomous-posting mode or model/credit allowance.
sections.zh: AI Studio 是助手界面，不是独立监听来源。请求需指定工作区、账户、任务及日期，输出受底层数据及支持工具影响。功能页要求检查拟执行动作，使用可得权限／确认，不能假设每条指令自主执行。编辑示例：按所选会话证据请求解释草稿，检查无支持主张，再单独核实所提供对外动作。公开资料未确定普遍审批层级、自主发布模式或模型／点数额度。

sections.title_en: An attempted action and provider acceptance remain different
sections.title_zh: 动作尝试与提供方接受仍不同
sections.en: The terms define outward completion by provider acceptance; the workspace can retain both attempt and result. Provider access changes can stop features, and reliability is not an uninterrupted-service promise. The security page describes provider authorization without sharing social passwords and encrypted connection credentials, as vendor declarations rather than audited guarantees. Editorial failure check: inspect the recorded attempt, provider outcome and native destination before repeating a publish/reply/delete action. No documented automatic retry timetable, duplicate-prevention contract or recovery SLA was found. Team membership and connection identity should be verified before changing access.
sections.zh: 条款以提供方接受定义对外动作完成，工作区可保留尝试及结果。提供方权限变化可能令功能停止，可靠性不等于持续服务承诺。安全页描述不分享社交密码的提供方授权、加密连接凭据，这是厂商说明而非审计保证。编辑故障检查：重做发布／回复／删除前查看尝试记录、提供方结果及原生目的地。未找到自动重试时间、防重复契约或恢复 SLA。更改访问前应核实团队成员与连接身份。

sections.title_en: Disconnecting a channel does not delete its saved history
sections.title_zh: 断开渠道不删除已存历史
sections.en: The privacy policy includes drafts, media, connected conversations, prompts/results, reports, receipts and error/audit records among stored operational data. Requested features may send necessary information to social, AI/media or research providers. Disconnecting stops new connection access but does not automatically erase saved posts/comments/reports or content already published natively. Account/workspace deletion may have a recovery period and required retention; fixed durations are not given. Editorial offboarding: separately inspect member access, provider revocation, saved workspace records and native content. The policy’s request route is not proof of immediate deletion of every copy.
sections.zh: 隐私政策列草稿、媒体、连接会话、提示／结果、报告、回执、错误／审计记录为运营存储数据。所请求功能可能向社交、AI／媒体或研究提供方发送必要信息。断开停止新增连接访问，不自动抹去已存帖子／评论／报告或已在原生平台发布内容。账户／工作区删除可能有恢复期及必要保留，未给固定期限。编辑退出建议：分别检查成员访问、提供方撤权、已存工作区记录及原生内容。政策请求路径不能证明立即删除全部副本。

seo.title_zh: Penguin ePulse：连接工作流程及研究边界
seo.description_en: Review Penguin ePulse/CleoUrban identity, calendar states, conversation scope, source-linked research, reporting and unresolved pricing.
seo.description_zh: 核对 Penguin ePulse／CleoUrban 身份、日历状态、会话范围、附来源研究、报告及未确定定价。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Penguin ePulse social workspace and market research scope
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Exact channel/account/format matrix, operational approval roles, queue behavior, retry/idempotency and support SLA remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 准确渠道／账户／格式矩阵、操作审批角色、队列行为、重试／幂等及支持 SLA 未核。

research_gaps.en: Plan amounts, seat/account quotas, free/trial eligibility, billing/cancellation/refund rules and provider-cost allowances remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 价格、席位／账户额度、免费／试用资格、账单／取消／退款及提供方费用额度未核。

research_gaps.en: Provider identities/coverage, historical depth, exports, model limits, fixed retention and recovery periods require account-specific confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 提供方身份／覆盖、历史深度、导出、模型限制、固定保留及恢复期限需按账户确认。

research_gaps.en: Source licence, self-hosting, region availability and dashboard-language support remain unknown.
research_gaps.zh: 源码许可、自托管、地区及仪表盘语言支持未知。

research_gaps.zh: 应用链接在公开阅读器超时，未进入账户、连接渠道、采集数据、确认付费或执行对外动作。
